title: ROME rank-one update encoded as a Mirror coordinate
hypothesis: A single shared rank-one physical template, with a one-scalar Givens View angle generated from each support-gradient signal, can represent many local rank-one edits with edit RMSE <=0.05 and locality RMSE <=0.05 at <=0.75x the actual inference-bank bytes of storing a separate ROME factor pair for each edit. An exact native Givens-angle control tests Mirror attribution.
physical_object: one frozen 24x24 base and one shared left/right rank-one template vector pair
mirror_coordinate: one per-edit angle that rotates the shared left and right vectors in opposite directions in a fixed 2D plane
logical_multiplicity: 20 simultaneous key-routed rank-one edits; 16 train the angle generator and four are held out
controls: direct ROME-style per-edit rank-one factors estimated from support
native shared-template Givens angle with the same one-scalar code
independent full-matrix least-squares support fit as quality upper

task.type: synthetic local edit bank; each target is rank one and lies on a shared-vector Givens orbit
task.keys: first 20 coordinate basis vectors in R^24, serialized in each inference bank

development.selection_metric: held-out edit RMSE, locality RMSE, wrong-route rate, actual serialized inference-bank bytes, editor-state bytes, and edit/query compute

storage.authority: actual serialized uncompressed .npz inference-bank payload bytes
paid_objects: all routing keys and radius metadata
ROME per-edit factor pairs OR Mirror shared vectors and per-edit angles
storage.separate_edit_generation_state: Report actual serialized editor bytes separately and report combined bank+editor bytes for systems that retain online code generation; the editor is not required to infer already serialized angles.

compute.operations: Routed query charges D^2 base application, 2D rank-one factor application (or decoded factors), and 20D distance scalar operations plus route comparisons. Angle decode includes two vector rotations and sin/cos per edit. Editor MAC/edit = D^2*32 + 32*1.

gates.PROMISING: Both development seeds: heldout edit RMSE <=0.05, locality RMSE <=0.05, wrong-route rate <=0.01, Mirror inference payload <=0.75x actual ROME factor-bank bytes, and independent upper edit RMSE <=0.025/locality <=0.05. If native Givens exactly aliases Mirror, report shared-template compression but classify no Mirror-specific benefit.
gates.FAIL: Independent upper passes its validity bounds but a frozen Mirror quality/storage gate fails, or direct native Givens exactly aliases the Mirror bank/output.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Independent full-update upper edit RMSE >0.025 or locality RMSE >0.05, route validity >0.01, or serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: Synthetic rank-one edits on a deliberately aligned Givens orbit; not factual language-model editing evidence.
All methods use the same nearest-key router and pay the same key table.

Inference-bank bytes exclude the edit-time generator only because stored per-edit angles/factors are sufficient for deterministic inference; generator state bytes and combined bank-plus-editor bytes are also reported.
Fresh worlds remain sealed unless all frozen gates pass; exact native alias disallows a Mirror-specific claim.
